newsitem.title: USA: U.S. barge rates - Rates thinly quoted on call.
newsitem.headline: U.S. barge rates - Rates thinly quoted on call.

text.p: U.S. barge rates were lightly quoted Tuesday on the St. Louis Merchants Exchange call session.
No barges traded versus four barges traded Monday.
- Two barges, Memphis, Mississippi River, $500 switch, this week, no bid, offer 105 percent, unchanged from Monday.
- Two barges, Illinois River, next week, bid 115 percent of tariff, no comparison, offer 125 percent, down five percentage points from Monday.
- Two barges, St Paul-Savage, upper Mississippi, next week, bid 170 percent, no comparison, offer 180 percent, no comparison.
